system_prompt:
You are taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in the fourth grade. Answer each question as well as you can.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
[Image: Temperature for Week graph]

The graph above shows the daily high and low temperatures for a week.

On which day is the difference between the high and low temperatures the greatest?

Figure, described in words:
A plot titled "Temperature for Week". The vertical axis is labeled "Temperature" with grid lines marked at 20°, 25°, 30°, 35°, 40°, and 45°. The horizontal axis is labeled "Day" with vertical grid lines marked at Sun., Mon., Tues., Wed., Thu., Fri., and Sat.
A legend on the right shows a filled black circle labeled "High Temp." and an open circle labeled "Low Temp."
The points plotted for each day are:
- Sun.: High Temp. at 39°, Low Temp. at 25°
- Mon.: High Temp. at 42°, Low Temp. at 24°
- Tues.: High Temp. at ~34°, Low Temp. at ~28°
- Wed.: High Temp. at 30°, Low Temp. at 20°
- Thu.: High Temp. at 26°, Low Temp. at ~23°
- Fri.: High Temp. at ~36°, Low Temp. at 25°
- Sat.: High Temp. at 45°, Low Temp. at 30°

A. Monday
B. Thursday
C. Friday
D. Saturday

answer.description: The letter of the option you choose for the question.
answer.title: Answer

llm_thinking: Calculating the differences for each day, Monday stands out with the largest gap at 18, so the answer is A.
